sloka: विभीषणमुखानां च सुहृदां राघवाज्ञया।सर्ववानरमुख्यानां चिकित्सां स तदा ऽकरोत् ।। ६.९२.२५ ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇamukhānāṁ ca suhṛdāṁ rāghavājñayā।sarvavānaramukhyānāṁ cikitsāṁ sa tadā 'karot ।। 6.92.25 ।।

translations.english: Then by Rama's order Vibheeshana and other friends and all Vanara leaders were healed.
